shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Lift the repository connection dialog above the workspace.

shadows.name: portrait-glow
shadows.purpose: Keep a restrained local halo behind the Shiro portrait.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The main action, such as connecting a repository or sending a message.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: #54E6F5; color: #090711; border: 1px solid #54E6F5; border-radius: 13px; padding: 10px 15px; font: 600 14px/1.2 Switzer, Inter, sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #8BF0FA; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F6F1FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: Secondary workspace controls and navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-quiet { background: #191628; color: #F6F1FF; border: 1px solid #342D4A; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 11px; font: 500 13px/1.3 Switzer, Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-quiet:hover { border-color: #A47CFF; color: #F6F1FF; } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #54E6F5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chat Input
components.html: <textarea class="ds-chat" aria-label="Ask SHIRO" placeholder="Ask about this codebase…"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-chat { background: #090711; color: #F6F1FF; border: 1px solid #342D4A; border-radius: 13px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 14px/1.55 Switzer, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-chat::placeholder { color: #B8B1C9; } .ds-chat:focus { border-color: #54E6F5; outline: 2px solid rgba(84, 230, 245, 0.24); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Selected Navigation
components.description: The active workspace view in the feature rail.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #191628; color: #54E6F5; border: 1px solid #342D4A; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 500 13px/1.3 Switzer, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #54E6F5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Evidence
components.description: An expandable real source excerpt supporting an answer.
components.css: .ds-evidence { background: #110F1C; color: #F6F1FF; border: 1px solid #342D4A; border-radius: 13px; padding: 12px; } .ds-evidence summary { color: #54E6F5; cursor: pointer; font: 500 13px/1.4 Switzer, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence pre { overflow: auto; color: #E2DAF3; font: 400 12px/1.65 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview: A dark, precise repository workspace with Shiro as its visible guide. The chat and real code evidence occupy the main work area while local character artwork and violet/cyan accents make the identity unmistakable.
keyCharacteristics: Character art is prominent, not a floating widget.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Accent glow cannot outrank question text, code, or source citations.

dos: Keep repository operations and evidence as the content of the experience.
Use local art and accessible standard controls.
donts: Do not invent metrics, code relationships, or AI activity.
Do not pretend static art is a rigged 3D character.
